scope: Selected named existing coverage before new implementation, not exhaustive census; test-engineer first reported gaps before editing.

12: a bound vector key rejects changed text before embedding and records the conflict
same key and text is unchanged while a changed text hash is rejected before provider write
semantic hits embedded by a different model cannot be compared with the query vector
13: instruction-looking title remains untrusted data and cannot change verified facts
instruction-looking abstract remains untrusted data and cannot change verified facts
instruction-looking generated profile remains untrusted data and cannot change verified facts
retrieved delimiter injection stays JSON data inside one untrusted block
14: two malformed synthesis outputs abstain and never call a model verifier
a fabricated subject cannot borrow another researcher's stored metrics
15: a missing evidence ID cannot authorize an otherwise correct count
wrong stored count is rejected and remains available in attempted-claim audit material
16: transient throttling retries once then succeeds with the same batch and bounded attempts
required audit persistence failure fails closed after otherwise valid synthesis
17: same idempotency key replays stored answer without a second workflow execution
duplicate queue payloads execute once across worker instances and acknowledge both receipts
18: missing and incorrect bearer credentials reject query and jobs before workflow
external bearer cannot authorize internal routes and internal token cannot authorize queries
malformed JSON and invalid constraint types are rejected before workflow
workflow downstream error and timeout preserve typed HTTP mapping with trace ID
19: structured request logs exclude authorization, extra headers, and malformed request content
20: authentication domains are separate with no usable default credentials

gaps: Full ingestion/retrieval/synthesis/verifier and real HTTP source-injection integration
Schema-valid fake identities/citations exercised through workflow with good-count controls
Faulting graph/vector/session ports with observed invocations, deadlines and recovery
Duplicate vector query keys and same-dimension stale model metadata
Per-required-key service config omission and config/header/exception canary redaction
